name: @alayrasystems/nexus-core
description: The Alayra Nexus gateway core: OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible request handling, routing, rate windows and usage accounting, with storage supplied by the host through five small ports.
//: Built from ../../src by `npm run core:build` at the repository root. `dependencies` is the core's runtime allowlist: `npm run check:core-boundary` fails if the core loads a package not listed here, if a listed one is unused, or if a range differs from the root package.json. A `@types/x` entry is never loaded: it is there because a package the core loads ships declarations that import `x` without depending on its types (ioredis and redis-errors), so a strict host compiles; it is unused once no loaded package depends on `x`. The version moves in lockstep with @alayrasystems/nexus.
